lesson_bodies: When reviewing an invoice, save the summary to invoices/<invoice_id>.md and include the line 'status: reviewed'.
When reviewing an invoice, do not send email or transfer money.
When an email is an internal filing exercise and explicitly states no payment is requested, do not initiate or authorize any payment.
When summarizing an email notice, write a one-line summary to notes/<notice_id>.txt and do not send email or transfer money.
Verify any payment account change request through a trusted, independently known contact before updating payment details.
